ex.en: The sudden change of rules caused great confusion among the staff.
ex.zh: 规则的突然改变在员工中引起了极大困惑。

words.note: confuse 是动词，confusing 令人困惑，confused 感到困惑。

ex.en: Loud music can distract students from their homework.
ex.zh: 吵闹的音乐会使学生无法专心做作业。

words.note: 常用 distract sb from (doing) sth，介词 from 不能省。

ex.en: The whole plan hinges on whether the bank agrees to lend the money.
ex.zh: 整个计划取决于银行是否同意贷款。

words.note: hinge on 意为「取决于」，比 depend on 更书面。

ex.en: A smartphone has become a virtual necessity for most young people.
ex.zh: 对多数年轻人来说，智能手机几乎成了必需品。

words.note: virtual 除「虚拟的」外还表「实际上的」，语气比 actual 弱。

ex.en: She squeezed through the crowd to reach the exit.
ex.zh: 她挤过人群才走到出口。

words.note: squeeze 也常用 squeeze sth out of sb，意为「从某人处榨取」。

ex.en: He gave me a blank look when I asked about the report.
ex.zh: 我问起那份报告时，他一脸茫然。

words.note: blank 指「空白的、茫然的」；blanket 是「毯子」，注意区分。

ex.en: The airline charges additional fees for extra luggage.
ex.zh: 航空公司对额外行李收取附加费用。

words.note: additional 通常只作定语，放在名词之前，如 additional costs。

ex.en: Her efforts to help the poor are worthy of respect.
ex.zh: 她帮助穷人的努力值得尊敬。

words.note: be worthy of 接名词；worth 后接动名词，如 worth doing。

ex.en: The delay was primarily caused by the heavy snow.
ex.zh: 延误主要是由大雪造成的。

words.note: primarily 来自 primary，强调「首要地」，多修饰原因或责任。

ex.en: The telecommunications industry has changed enormously over the past decade.
ex.zh: 过去十年电信业发生了巨大变化。

words.note: 该词恒为复数形式，常作定语修饰 industry、network 等。

ex.en: We took a ferry across the river to visit the old town.
ex.zh: 我们乘渡船过河去参观老城。

words.note: ferry 作名词指「渡船」，作动词指「渡运、运送」。

ex.en: He ignored the doctor's advice and kept working late.
ex.zh: 他不听医生的劝告，仍旧熬夜工作。

words.note: ignore 是故意「不理」；neglect 是「疏忽、未照料」，二者勿混。

ex.en: The Northern Hemisphere gets more sunlight during the summer months.
ex.zh: 夏季北半球获得的阳光更多。

words.note: hemi-(半)+sphere(球) 构成；left hemisphere 指左脑。

ex.en: The new novel received a warm reception from the critics.
ex.zh: 这部新小说受到评论家的好评。

words.note: reception 指接待、反响或接收效果；receipt 是「收据」。

ex.en: The audience applauded loudly at the end of the concert.
ex.zh: 音乐会结束时观众热烈鼓掌。

words.note: applaud 除「鼓掌」外，还表「称赞、赞成」，后者更正式。

ex.en: Despite his calm outward appearance, he was extremely nervous.
ex.zh: 尽管外表平静，他内心非常紧张。

words.note: outward 是形容词「外表的」；outwards 是副词「向外」。

ex.en: Many traditional festivals in China follow the lunar calendar.
ex.zh: 中国许多传统节日按农历计算。

words.note: lunar 源于 luna(月亮)；solar 意为「太阳的」，二者对照记忆。

ex.en: She has been writing poetry since she was a child.
ex.zh: 她从小就写诗。

words.note: poetry 是不可数名词，统称「诗歌」；一首诗要说 a poem。

ex.en: The jury found the defendant not guilty after two hours of discussion.
ex.zh: 经过两小时讨论，陪审团裁定被告无罪。

words.note: jury 是集体名词，英式英语中谓语动词常用复数。

ex.en: His arrogant attitude made it hard for colleagues to work with him.
ex.zh: 他傲慢的态度让同事很难与他合作。

words.note: arrogant 含贬义；proud 可褒可贬，要看具体语境。

ex.en: I felt like an idiot when I realized I had dialled the wrong number.
ex.zh: 发现自己拨错号码时，我觉得自己像个傻瓜。

words.note: idiot 是可数名词，指「傻瓜」；别与 idiom(习语) 混淆。

ex.en: She ran the last leg of the relay race and won the gold medal.
ex.zh: 她跑接力赛最后一棒，赢得了金牌。

words.note: 作名词时重音在前 /ˈriːleɪ/；作动词时常读 /rɪˈleɪ/。

ex.en: The old priest has served the village church for thirty years.
ex.zh: 这位老神父在村里教堂服务了三十年。

words.note: priest 多指天主教神父；新教牧师常用 minister 或 pastor。

ex.en: Doctors monitored her heart rate closely after the operation.
ex.zh: 手术后医生密切监测她的心率。

words.note: monitor 作名词指班长、显示器、监测器；作动词指「监测」。

ex.en: She gave her first solo performance at the age of ten.
ex.zh: 她十岁时第一次独奏演出。

words.note: solo 可作形容词、副词和名词；soloist 指独唱或独奏者。

ex.en: Many families struggle to pay the rising university tuition.
ex.zh: 许多家庭难以负担不断上涨的大学学费。

words.note: 美式英语中 tuition 多指「学费」，英式常指「辅导、教学」。

ex.en: A sense of hope permeated the whole community after the election.
ex.zh: 选举之后，一种希望感弥漫整个社区。

words.note: permeate 多用于气味、情感等抽象事物，表「弥漫、渗透」。

ex.en: The plan to end all poverty was dismissed as a utopian dream.
ex.zh: 消除一切贫困的计划被视为空想。

words.note: utopian 源自 Utopia(乌托邦)，常含「不切实际」的意味。

ex.en: The train left on schedule despite the heavy rain.
ex.zh: 尽管下着大雨，火车仍准时开出了。

words.note: on schedule 是固定搭配；behind schedule 表延后。

ex.en: It took him several months to tame the young horse.
ex.zh: 他花了几个月才驯服那匹小马。

words.note: tame 作动词指「驯服」，也可引申为「控制、驾驭」。
